This run was orchestrated by an LLM agent — the prompt below was translated into the workflow you see in the rest of the report. The plan and final response are the agent's own narrative; the timeline, decision audit, and full transcript expose every step the agent took along the way.

❝ You

Design a protein sequence that exhibits the desired activity and specificity.

1. The presence of Mg(2+) is necessary for the protein to function in the desired environment.
2. The AMP, (6S)-NADPHX binding site should be located in a region of the protein that is accessible to the ligand.
3. The designed protein should have ATP binding, NADPHX epimerase activity, metal ion binding, ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity to facilitate nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.
4. For general function, the protein need meet that Catalyzes the epimerization of the S- and R-forms of NAD(P)HX, a damaged form of NAD(P)H that is a result of enzymatic or heat-dependent hydration

Use listed tools for generation. Because no fixed scaffold or ligand-bound structure is provided, perform a de novo RF diffusion style backbone design round, then inverse-fold candidate sequences, refold the top candidate, analyze/QC it, rank the result, and return one output protein sequence.

✦ Agent plan

Create a local post hoc follow-up bundle from the completed best candidate by regenerating full-chain structural analysis and deterministic ranking artifacts from existing outputs only, so the run is ready for downstream report/visualization assembly without additional scientific inference.

⚙ System

You are the VPA planning agent for local, reproducible
protein-design workflows.

Use only provided VPA tools/templates. Prefer matching workflow templates over
ad hoc low-level chains. For vague biology, use literature_search first; use
go_sequences/interpro_sequences for GO, InterPro, family, function, or annotation
queries; use template_select before template-guided design; use sequence_analysis
and structure_analysis at round boundaries; use sequence_edit for explicit repair
rounds; use rfdiffusion for backbone, motif, partial diffusion, binder, fold, and
symmetric design tasks when VPA validation says it is ready.

When selected tool metadata includes `sharding`, prefer workflow-level fan-out:
use `foreach` over seed/candidate lists, keep expensive generator shards at the
tool's `recommended_shard_size` (often `num_designs: 1` or one seed), and set
`max_parallel` to the user's GPU budget or the tool's `default_max_parallel`.
For ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN, keep warm batches together unless `num_designs` is
above the sharding threshold in the metadata.

Never invent tools, bypass validation, send raw large artifacts to the LLM, use
cloud scientific/GPU inference, or change scientific parameters without recording
the reason. Return only JSON matching the requested contract.

The first output character must be `{` and the final output character must be
`}`. Do not output comments, XML tags, Markdown fences, prose, thinking text, or
a quoted JSON string.

Structure analysis

Structure analysis runs DSSP (or a pydssp / CA-geometry fallback) on the predicted structure, classifies secondary structure per residue, computes relative surface accessibility, and tabulates inter-chain / ligand contacts. The strip below shows SS and burial along the sequence; the table breaks every residue out for sorting and filtering.

Quality Control

QC aggregates fast, deterministic biochemical checks computed from the sequence + predicted structure: mean pLDDT, instability index, GRAVY, pI, polybasic motifs, and pTM/ipTM when available. Each card below shows the value, the threshold-based quality (green / amber / red), and what it means. Flags below the cards summarise which thresholds were tripped.

Mean pLDDT

Predicted local-distance difference test — per-residue confidence averaged over the chain. ≥70 confident · ≥90 very high.

Instability Index

Guruprasad et al. (1990) heuristic from amino-acid pair frequencies. <40 = predicted stable in vitro.

GRAVY

Grand Average of Hydropathy (Kyte-Doolittle). Negative = hydrophilic / likely soluble; positive = hydrophobic / membrane-associated.

Isoelectric point

pH at which the protein has net zero charge. Typical soluble proteins span 4-9. Buffer choice should sit at least 1 unit away.

Polybasic motifs

Count of K/R-rich runs that can drive non-specific binding to membranes or RNA. 0 is ideal.

⚠️ contains_polybasic_clusterQC flag — see the protein_qc adapter documentation.
⚠️ high_instability_indexInstability index >40 suggests the sequence may not be stable in vitro.
